Eight US States Sue OpenAI Over ChatGPT Harms to Young Users

Eight US states have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, alleging that the artificial intelligence product exposes young users to dangerous behavior. The states claim the company's products are harming children en masse and are seeking to compel OpenAI to alter how its products function for young users. The lawsuit was filed on Wednesday.
